COS can bind wheat plasma membrane proteins and some potential COS binding proteins have been identified.

the interaction of COS and plasma membrane proteins and the identification of COS binding proteins, providing new insight for understanding the mechanism of COS on the cell surface.
the identification of plasma membrane proteins that interact with COS, and it will provide a basis for further study of the mechanism of COS on plant immunity.
the identification of COS binding proteins, which provides a new insight into the molecular mechanisms underlying the COS-induced immune response in plants.

the interaction between COS and wheat plasma membrane proteins may be a key step for the activation of plant immune system.
COS binding proteins were enriched on plasma membrane and the candidates were identified.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the plasma membrane of the wheat leaf cells was a target site of COS, which was associated with COS binding proteins.
the plasma membrane proteins of wheat leaf cell were involved in the interaction of COS, which provided a novel insight into the interaction of COS and plants.

the COS receptors are present in the wheat plasma membrane.

the interaction of COS and wheat leaf plasma membrane proteins may be one of the reasons for the activation of plant immune system.
